prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity mobile-first web landing page compositional comp, option 3
Primary request: Design a shippable 9:16 portrait mobile landing viewport for SettleUp. It must communicate reciprocal friend-group spending over time: Jamie pays for pizza, Noor later gets drinks and plates, Eli covers gas and utilities, and the app uses real connected bank transactions to show how the group evens out without demanding a cent-by-cent repayment after every purchase. This is a practical responsive website screenshot, not a poster, mood board, physical phone photograph, or concept-art scene.
Structure: edge-to-edge cream paper. A slim header with SettleUp and Sign in. A large editorial-serif headline occupies the upper-left third with a concise subline and smaller terracotta Connect a bank action. The dominant object is an abstract hand-drawn circular social ledger, not a geographic landscape: three friend nodes sit around a central “Weekend crew” ledger, each node paired with a precise transaction slip. Graphite paths are traced progressively around the circle, with terracotta showing money spent and sage showing value returned; paths are visibly designed to rotate/reveal on scroll. At the bottom edge, a cropped continuation reveals the connected-phone circle that the camera will zoom out to on the next scroll stage. One dominant move: a circular ledger map that turns individual purchases into a group relationship.
Direction: Field Note Constellation with the preferred type character from the Shared Ledger Study. Confident high-contrast editorial serif for the headline and SettleUp wordmark; restrained clean sans-serif for exact money and controls; sparse handwritten labels for map annotation only. Industrial sketchbook plus social-map notation: graphite, ink, paper tooth, small pinned transaction slips, sparse crosshatching, deliberate leader lines. Notion-like calm and clarity.
Color palette: cream #EEE8DA dominant, near-black #292824, terracotta #D57B4E, sage #8F9278.
Text (verbatim, no other prose): “SettleUp”, “Sign in”, “No need to count every cent.”, “Connect your bank. See how the group evens out.”, “Connect a bank”, “Weekend crew”, “Jamie · Pizza · $84.20”, “Noor · Drinks + plates · $46.80”, “Eli · Gas + utilities · $112.40”, “It comes around”, “Keep scrolling”.
Constraints: exact readable money; honest bank-connected mechanism; accessible hierarchy; standard phone ratio; one dominant visual move; no invented claims or metrics; no geographical mountains or travel scenery; no stock photography; use simple drawn initials or silhouette portraits; no gradients; no glassmorphism; no generic card grid; no cartoonish fintech illustration; no neon; no purple; no watermark; no extra text; no illegible microtext. Show enough lower continuation to prove this is a scroll story.
